name: Country flag artwork
author: Hampus Borgos and country-flags contributors; artwork sourced from Wikimedia Commons.
note: PNG renderings of the source SVGs; artwork and proportions unchanged. Includes 249 ISO countries and territories, plus Kosovo (XK). The Antarctic flag is an unofficial design.

name: New Caledonia flag
author: User:WarX
note: Kanak flag (FLNKS), flown officially alongside the French tricolour since 2010. Rendered by Wikimedia as PNG and scaled to 768 pixels wide.

name: Saint Pierre and Miquelon flag
author: André Paturel
note: Local flag. Rendered by Wikimedia as PNG and scaled to 768 pixels wide.

name: Saint Helena, Ascension and Tristan da Cunha flag
author: Patricia Fidi
note: Flag of Saint Helena. Rendered by Wikimedia as PNG and scaled to 768 pixels wide.

name: Réunion flag
author: Ch1902
note: Lo Mahavéli, a widely flown unofficial flag; the French tricolour is the official flag. Rendered by Wikimedia as PNG and scaled to 768 pixels wide.

name: Saint Martin flag
author: Government of the Collectivity of Saint-Martin, vectorised by Flagvisioner
note: Local flag of the Collectivity of Saint Martin; the French tricolour is the official flag. Rendered by Wikimedia as PNG and scaled to 768 pixels wide.

name: Saint Barthélemy flag
author: Germenfer
note: Local flag; the French tricolour is the official flag. Rendered by Wikimedia as PNG and scaled to 768 pixels wide.

name: Guadeloupe, Martinique, French Guiana and Mayotte flag
author: Wikimedia Commons contributors
note: Local flags shared with the France collection; see France in Acknowledgements for each source. Rendered by Wikimedia as PNG and scaled to 768 pixels wide.

name: Northern Cyprus flag
author: Wikimedia Commons contributors
note: Flag of the Turkish Republic of Northern Cyprus. Rendered by Wikimedia as PNG and scaled to 768 pixels wide.
